description: This file contains the implementation of the NodeId class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages network address representations, including IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, and Bluetooth addresses. The code includes methods for address resolution, comparison, and address manipulation, as well as static utility functions for address validation and formatting.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node address, supporting IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, Netlink, Bluetooth, and raw socket addresses. Provides methods for address comparison, resolution, and formatting.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId instances for equality based on their address structures.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns address data from various socket address structures or union SocketInfo to the NodeId instance.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname or address string associated with the NodeId, resolving it if necessary.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the address (IPv4, IPv6, or Bluetooth).

methods.name: AnyInterface
methods.description: Returns a NodeId representing any network interface of the same type.

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId represents any interface (all zeros).

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId refers to a local loopback or localhost address.

methods.name: Origin
methods.description: Returns a NodeId representing the origin address (e.g., zero address).

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Provides the default network mask based on the address type.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname or address string into the internal address structure, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Returns a broadcast address based on the current address and mask.
